network.title: Network

network.url: HTTP / HTTPS proxy URL (without username or password)
network.restart: Changes take effect after restarting the backend or desktop app.
network.saved: Saved. Restart the backend or desktop app to apply.

network.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the proxy URL and try again.
network.conflict: Configuration changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
